newsitem.title: GHANA: Mobil Oil strong on quiet Ghana bourse.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Oil strong on quiet Ghana bourse.

text.p: Mobil Oil Ghana rose 100 cedis to 6,100 in a quiet session of the Ghana Stock Exchange on Monday, trading results showed.
The GSE All-Share Index advanced 0.84 points to 376.68 and total market capitalisation rose to 3,268.00 billion cedis from 3,266.82 billion.
Offers exceeded bids by 918,650 shares to 46,420, but only 16,620 were traded.
Social Security Bank was the most active equity, rising three cedis to 1,021 on turnover of 11,100 shares. Mobil traded 2,400 shares.

Ghana Commercial Bank rose three to 695 and Pioneer Aluminium Factory and CFAO rose one cedi each to 149 and 26 cedis respectively. Enterprise Insurance fell two cedis to 438. The other 14 first list equities were unchanged.
